positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on Stadia doing various Vulkan and video encoding related things from my join date in Dec 2018 until it was shut down in Sept 2022.  After Stadia I moved to a new org and began working on AR/VR, which I'm still working on at present.

positions.title: Software Apps Engineer
positions.description: I analyzed performance of applications, primarily games, on Apple MacOS products using Intel GPUs and worked with ISVs or Intel's driver team to remedy any issues that were discovered.

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on graphics drivers for Apple MacOS products.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
CiiNOW is a cloud gaming service (the user’s input is sent over the network to the server running a PC game and video is streamed from the server to the user).  I added features and fixed bugs in the server side code responsible for interacting with the games running on the server (this code intercepts Windows calls to modify game behavior and 3D graphics calls to grab the rendered frames to stream).
I also implemented lightweight app level virtualization to enable multiple instances of an application to run simultaneously on one server.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the graphics drivers for the Intel HD graphics hardware on the Sandybrige, Ivybridge, and Haswell processors (as well as upcoming processors).  My main tasks included development of Geometry Shader and Stream Out features in the driver for DirectX10, and design and development of the tessellation pipeline in the driver (Hull Shader, Domain Shader) for DirectX11.
